meta.notes: Times are in minutes. push_pull_stops: positive = push, negative = pull, 0 = box speed. rotary_* flags indicate continuous/rotary agitation.

schema.film: Film name as listed in Massive Dev Chart
schema.shot_iso: ISO the film was exposed at
schema.nominal_iso: Film's box speed (inferred from name or most common ISO)
schema.push_pull_stops: Push/pull in stops (+N push, -N pull, 0 = box speed)
schema.time_35mm: Development time in minutes for 35mm (null if N/A)
schema.time_120: Development time in minutes for 120 (null if N/A)
schema.time_sheet: Development time in minutes for sheet film (null if N/A)
schema.rotary_35mm: True if 35mm time requires rotary/continuous agitation
schema.rotary_120: True if 120 time requires rotary/continuous agitation
schema.rotary_sheet: True if sheet time requires rotary/continuous agitation
schema.has_notes: True if additional notes exist on MDC
schema.devrow_id: MDC row ID — fetch notes at digitaltruth.com/devchart.php?devrow=ID
